unit_of_export: one adapter envelope over a Gaia ResidueGraph induced site view, one experimental ligand occurrence, and contributing Gaia pockets

cavity_layer.raw_nodes: Every contributing fpocket alpha sphere with stable pocket/sphere ID, center and radius
cavity_layer.derived_edges: Undirected sphere pairs whose surface gap is <= 1.0 A; store center distance and signed surface gap independently
cavity_layer.authority: Raw AlphaSphereSet; derived adjacency is rebuildable adapter output

missingness_policy: Every optional feature has an availability state; unavailable observations are null plus a reason, never numeric zero.
cofactor_policy: SAM, SAH, SFG, and other cofactors remain distinct explicit atom subgraphs and are never folded into pocket summary features.
score_policy: No Vina score, docking-derived affinity, master score, or METTL7 computational class is present in training features or labels.
coordinate_policy: Store source Cartesian coordinates; graph models may construct translation/rotation-invariant distances and equivariant relative vectors at load time.
determinism: Stable IDs derive from source keys; rows and adjacency lists sort lexicographically; schema, source artifacts, grouping rules, and split assignments are content-addressed.
